nodes.description: Public mapping balanceOf(address=>uint) holding token balances
Public nested mapping allowance(owner=>spender=>uint)
Private owner address set from msg.sender in constructor, used as privileged guard
Public totalSupply uint assigned from constructor argument
transfer(address _to,uint _value) payable forwarding to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) guarded by ensure(), mutates allowance/balanceOf with raw arithmetic
approve(address _spender,uint _value) writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate(address a,bytes b) owner-only wrapper performing arbitrary delegatecall
batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) owner-only loop with unchecked balance math and double Transfer events
modifier ensure(address _from,address _to) restricting transfers to owner or computed UNI pair
pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) pure helper computing the Uniswap pair address
payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and infinite allowance
msg.sender - caller controlled address used for auth, allowance keys and transfers
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary attacker supplied bytecode in this contract storage
Raw -= and += / multiplication on balanceOf, allowance and totals without SafeMath
require(msg.sender == owner) access-control check inside delegate and batchSend
Parameter _to of transfer
Parameter _from of transferFrom
Parameter _value of transferFrom, transfer and batchSend
Parameter _spender of approve
Parameter a (callee address) of delegate
Parameter b (calldata bytes) of delegate
Parameter _tos address array of batchSend
Local UNI pair address computed by pairFor inside ensure modifier
Local loop counter i in batchSend
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend

edges.reason: msg.sender keys allowance[_from][msg.sender] and passes the authorization branch in transferFrom
msg.sender is the owner key written into allowance in approve
msg.sender balance is debited and used in the Transfer events of batchSend
Caller controlled msg.sender is compared against stored owner for authorization
The owner require is the only gate before delegate executes delegatecall
Caller supplied bytes b flows directly into the delegatecall payload
delegate executes external code in the context of this contract storage (external callback)
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf balanceOf arithmetic
allowance mapping values are mutated with raw subtraction potentially underflowing
balanceOf mapping values are mutated with raw add/sub potentially overflowing or underflowing
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
The ensure modifier restricts who may call transferFrom
ensure calls pairFor to derive the allowed Uniswap pair address
pairFor return value is stored in the local UNI variable
Constructor assigns the _supply argument into totalSupply
Constructor sets owner and initial balances/allowance from msg.sender
msg.sender becomes the privileged owner state variable
transferFrom debits and credits the balanceOf mapping
approve writes the allowance mapping
batchSend mutates the balanceOf mapping for sender and every recipient
_value parameter controls the allowance and balance amounts in transferFrom
_from parameter selects the debited account and the ensure check in transferFrom
_to parameter is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom
_spender parameter is the allowance key in approve
Target address a parameter is the delegatecall target in delegate
_tos array drives the recipient loop in batchSend
Loop counter i controls iteration bound in batchSend
Computed total is compared against the caller balance in batchSend

Source address parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom and its ensure guard
Amount parameter feeds the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom/transfer/batchSend
Spender parameter only keys the allowance write in approve
Target address parameter exists only as the delegatecall target in delegate
Calldata bytes parameter flows directly into the raw delegatecall payload
Recipient array parameter only drives the batchSend loop
UNI is a temporary local holding the pairFor result used by the ensure modifier
Loop index i is local bookkeeping of the batchSend iteration
total is the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication result
